articles.title: Wade Faulkner Wins Nomination 478th District Judge
articles.excerpt: On Aug. 9, 2022, the Bell County Republican Party's district executive committee chose Faulkner from three candidates as its nominee for the 478th District Judge seat on the November 2022 ballot (KCEN).

articles.title: Three Republicans Vying for 426th District Court Judgeship
articles.excerpt: As a military judge he presided over the death penalty trial of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan (KDH).

articles.title: Duskie Parker to Vie for 426th Judge Runoff
articles.excerpt: In 2020 he ran in the Republican primary for the 426th District Court, finishing third with 23% of the vote (KDH).

articles.title: Locals Vying for County Seats in Primary Elections
articles.excerpt: 2026 election: He was unopposed in the March 2026 Republican primary, and no Democrat filed (KDH).
